nom: Dr. Althea Premium Quick Step Sebum Cleanser

avis.titre: gets the job done, kinda minty, will have to repurchase the nose pads and tools
avis.texte: i swear by dr. althea products because of their quality and this one gets the job done! it has a bit of a minty/mentholy smell but feels cool when applied to the skin. comes with the cotton swabs and nose patches as a pictured and with enough to last a while but not enough to use the whole bottle with. the usage is self explanatory and it does get all the gunk/sebacious filaments out!! i recommend dousing the nose pad in more of the solution than you’d think because it needs to be very moist to be effective. the bottle has a pump nozzle so it’s easy to waste product if you’re not careful but works great! also recommend proper aftercare to make sure the effects are consistent.
Doesn't work at all. Followed the directions and it never did anything to my nose.

This is amazing. Softens everything stuck in the pores. You do have to go through and manually extract after, but everything comes out so easily. If you go through the pads, just use cotton rounds or gauze or order more.

avis.titre: Not what I expectedNot what I expected
avis.texte: The pads feel soft and luxurious, and the product is gentle and refreshing to use. It’s a nice step for light cleansing and skin prep. However, it doesn’t come with enough pads for the price, and despite regular use, it did not remove blackheads or noticeably clear clogged pores for me. It works more as a mild maintenance product than a deep pore cleanser. Overall, pleasant to use but underwhelming in results

i really liked it it helps getting out the sebum from your pores, the only thing is that you’re going to have to applied pressure so that it comes out but it is less than normally, and most of them come out completely. If you have a lot of sebaceous filaments is going to take more than one time to make it look very clean, but after one time it left my nose visibly more clean.
